reference_sql:
SELECT o.order_id, l.product_id
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.channel = 'web'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-07 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 00:00:00'
alternatives: SELECT o.order_id, l.product_id FROM order_lines l RIGHT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'web' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-07 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 00:00:00'
SELECT o.order_id, l.product_id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'web' AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-07'

other_way.sql: SELECT o.order_id, l.product_id FROM order_lines l RIGHT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'web' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-07 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 00:00:00'
other_way.tradeoff: RIGHT JOIN keeps the order with no lines too, but a reader must look past the join to see which table stays whole.
